en-CA.summary: Get live train, tube, and bus departures for the Transport for London stops   nearest to your house.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask london departures to check my stations
Alexa, ask london departures for my next trains
en-CA.name: London Departures
en-CA.description:
London Departures is your ultimate commuting companion. Built for
  Londoners, this skill uses your device's location to automatically find the
  closest TfL bus stops, Tube stations, or National Rail stations to your
  current position.
  Simply ask Alexa to open London Departures, and she will provide a live,
  real-time board of the upcoming trains or buses so you know exactly when to
  leave the house. If you have an Echo Show, the skill also features a
  beautiful dark-mode visual departure board that can be pinned directly to
  your home screen as a widget!
